izzyondroid:de.eric_scheibler.tactileclo.name: Tactile Clock
izzyondroid:de.eric_scheibler.tactileclo.summary: Double click the power button of your device to vibrate the current time
izzyondroid:de.eric_scheibler.tactileclo.description:
This Android app vibrates the current time when the display is locked and you double-click the power button of your device.
 How it works
 Double-click the power button. This might take some practice to work reliably. Press slowly and deliberately. If you double-click too fast the system only recognizes a single click and turns the screen on instead.
 The time vibration is structured as follows:
 A short vibration stands for the digit 1 and a long one for the digit 5. The 2 is represented by two consecutive short vibrations, the 6 by a long and a short one and so on. The 0 constitutes an exception with two long vibrations.
 Examples:
 00:00 = -- --
 01:18 = . . -...
 02:51 = .. - .
 10:11 = . -- . .
 19:06 = . -.... -.
 Explanation:
 The time is processed digit by digit:
 . = short vibration
 - = long vibration
 Leading zeros in the hour and minute fields are omitted.
 Gaps:
 To simplify the recognition of the vibration pattern, there exist three kind of gaps with different durations:
 []: A short gap between vibrations in the same digit
 [  ]: A medium gap for the separation of two digits within the hour and minute field
 [    ]: A long gap to split hours and minutes
 Additional features
 Keep informed about the current time. The app can vibrate the current time automatically every X minutes or every hour.
 Play the Greenwich Time Signal at the start of each hour, similar to a radio station.
 Trigger time vibration with Tasker (see below for details)
 Decide what to do if you double-click when the display is on. You can choose between a warning vibration and having the time vibrated as well.
 The app starts automatically after the system reboots.
 Double-click conflict
 TactileClock is triggered by clicking the power button twice in quick succession. This may conflict with the 'built-in' double-click action of your Android device. For example, a Google Pixel device will typically launch the camera when the power button is double-clicked; a Samsung device may take a screenshot when the power button is double-clicked.
 If your device has a 'built-in' action when the power button is double-clicked, there are three options to get TactileClock working.
 Option 1: Disable the 'built-in' double-click action of your device.
 Google Pixel: (Settings > System > Gestures > Quickly open camera)
 Samsung Galaxy: (Settings > Advanced Features > Side Button > Double Press)
 Other devices may require different settings to disable the double-click action.
 Once the 'built-in' double-click action has been disabled, double-clicking the power button will trigger the TactileClock action.
 Option 2: Configure TactileClock to trigger after a long double-click.
 This will allow the 'built-in' double-click action to co-exist with the TactileClock double-click action.
 1. Open TactileClock 2. Swipe left to show the 'Shortcut' screen. 3. Modify the 'Click Interval:'. 3a. Set 'From:' to be 500ms. 3b. Set 'To:' to be 1500ms. 
 The From: and To: values specified above should work, but may need to be adjusted for optimal results on your device. Once configured, a fast double-click will trigger your devices 'built-in' action, while a slow double-click will trigger the TactileClock action.
 Option 3: Use Tasker to trigger time vibration with custom events

izzyondroid:helium314.localbackend.name: Local NLP Backend
izzyondroid:helium314.localbackend.summary: Location provider for UnifiedNlp and microG using only local data.
izzyondroid:helium314.localbackend.description:
The backend passively monitors the GPS and scans for nearby WiFis and mobile cells/towers. From this a database of emitter locations is created. When UnifiedNlp / microG request a location from Local NLP Backend , a scan for nearby emitter is initiated and a location determined based on the scan results.
 Local NLP Backend is a fork of the Déjà Vu NLP Backend with some improvements and a crude UI for configuration and importing / exporting data, including cell lists from MLS or OpenCelliD.
 This backend uses no network data. All data acquired by the phone stays on the phone, though it may be exported manually.
 How to use: 
 Local NLP Backend can be used like Déjà Vu: just enable the backend and let it build up the database by frequently having GPS enabled, e.g. using a map app. If you have a Déjà Vu database (you'll need root privileged to extract it), it can be imported in Local NLP Backend. Further import options are databases exported by Local NLP Backend, and cell csv files from MLS or OpenCelliD. Note that the local database needs to be filled, either using GPS or by importing data, before Local NLP Backend can provide locations!
 In order to speed up building the database, LocalNLP has an optional active mode that enabled GPS when there is no known emitter nearby (low setting) or when any unknown emitter is found (aggressive setting).
 Note that microG has stopped supporting UnifiedNlp backends with 0.2.28. If you still want to use this backend (or others), you need to use older microG versions. This can only be recommended if you use microG for location only . Personally I use 0.2.10 , as with later versions location backends stop providing locations after some time.

izzyondroid:moe.shizuku.privileged.api.name: Shizuku
izzyondroid:moe.shizuku.privileged.api.summary: using system APIs directly with adb/root privileges from normal apps
izzyondroid:moe.shizuku.privileged.api.description:
When developing apps that requires root, the most common method is to run some commands in the su shell. For example, there is app uses pm enable/disable command to enable/disable components. This method has very big disadvantages:
 Extremely slow (Multiple process creation)
 Needs to process texts (Super unreliable)
 The possibility is limited to available commands
 Even if adb has sufficient permissions, the app requires root privileges to run
 Shizuku uses a completely different way. The most important feature Shizuku provides is something like be a middle man to receive requests from the app, sent to the system server, and send back the results. To the app, it is almost identical to the use system APIs directly. But it's much faster as it hooks into the system directly.
 Several apps already use Shizuku . If you want to integrate it with yours, take a look at the Developer guide . For users, there's also a User guide .

fdroid:app.fayaz.otgmaster.name: OTG Master
fdroid:app.fayaz.otgmaster.summary: Mount VeraCrypt, LUKS, BitLocker and APFS USB drives on non-rooted Android
fdroid:app.fayaz.otgmaster.description:
OTG Master lets you mount VeraCrypt, LUKS and BitLocker-encrypted USB drives, and read Mac APFS drives, directly on your Android device — no root required.
Connect an encrypted volume via USB OTG, enter your password or use your fingerprint, and access your encrypted files through Android's built-in Files app. Unmount safely when done.
FEATURES
• Multiple Encryption Formats — mount VeraCrypt, LUKS1, LUKS2 and BitLocker volumes (BitLocker with its password or 48-digit recovery key)
• Broad File System Support — read and write files on FAT32, exFAT, NTFS and ext4 partitions
• Mac Drives — read APFS drives, unencrypted or encrypted with a password, case-sensitive or not
• Read-Only Mode — optionally mount partitions safely without risking accidental modifications
• ext4 Repair — a drive that wasn't unmounted cleanly opens read-only; one tap replays its journal, as Linux would, and makes it writable again
• Auto Mount — automatically unlocks known drives on connect using biometric authentication
• Hub Support — multiple USB drives connected via a hub are all prompted in a single biometric step
• VeraCrypt Hidden Volumes — open a hidden volume with its own password, and protect it from damage while writing to its outer volume
• Keyfile Support — use a keyfile in addition to or instead of a password
• Custom PIM — supports non-default PIM values for stronger key derivation
• Cipher Selection — AES, Serpent and Twofish, VeraCrypt's five cascades of them, and SHA-512 or Argon2id key derivation
• Encrypt a Drive — turn a USB partition into a new VeraCrypt volume, with any of those ciphers, a PIM and keyfiles, or a LUKS2 volume for Linux; FAT32, exFAT, ext4 or NTFS inside
• Format — erase a partition in place as FAT32, exFAT, ext4 or NTFS, keeping its encryption and password
• Backups — back up folders between the phone and a drive, as plain copies or incremental snapshots in the standard restic format that restic opens on a computer; browse a backup as a read-only drive; reminders when one is overdue
• Recover Deleted Files — find files deleted from FAT32 and exFAT drives and copy them to the phone; only deleted files are listed, and nothing is written to the drive
• Phones and Cameras — another phone or a camera connected over USB shows up as a drive (read-only)
• Tablet Layout — on a wide screen, mounted drives sit beside the unlock form
• Partitioned Disks — scans MBR/GPT partition tables and lets you pick the exact volume to unlock
• No Root Required — works on standard, unmodified Android devices
• No Cloud, No Tracking — your files never leave your device
REQUIREMENTS
• Android 8.0 (Oreo) or later
• USB OTG cable or adapter
• A VeraCrypt, LUKS or BitLocker-encrypted USB drive, or an APFS drive from a Mac
OTG Master is free and open source.

fdroid:com.iwadjp.pixeltagdrawer.name: Pixel Tag Drawer
fdroid:com.iwadjp.pixeltagdrawer.summary: Organize and launch Android apps with tags and usage-based sorting.
fdroid:com.iwadjp.pixeltagdrawer.description:
Pixel Tag Drawer is a companion app for Android. It lists the launchable apps
on your device and lets you organise and filter them with your own tags. It
does not act as a home launcher; you keep using it alongside your existing
launcher.
Features:
* App list: shows launchable apps as "all apps", a selected tag, or "no tag",
 in a list or grid view.
* Tags: assign multiple tags to one app; create, rename and delete tags, and
 add or remove a tag on many apps at once.
* AND filter: show only the apps that have all of the selected tags.
* Search: filter the list by app name or package name.
* Sorting: by name, by most recently launched, by launch count, or by a
 usage-based "recommended" order.
* Pinned shortcuts: add a home-screen shortcut that opens a specific tag
 filter or the "no tag" filter.
Usage access (optional):
* The "recently launched", "launch count" and "recommended" sort orders use
 Android's UsageStats and UsageEvents, aggregated on the device (last 30 days
 for the first two, last 7 days for "recommended").
* These orders require granting "usage access" to the app manually in Android
 settings. There is no runtime permission dialog for it.
* If usage access is not granted, name sorting, search, tag organisation and
 tag filtering still work, and the usage-based orders fall back to name order.
Privacy and network:
* Works locally on the device. The app does not request the INTERNET
 permission and has no code that sends data to an external server.
* No account, no cloud sync.
* No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
Requires Android 8.0 (API 26) or later. Developed and tested on a Pixel 10a;
behaviour on other devices or launchers is not verified.

fdroid:com.noirgym.app.name: Noir Gym
fdroid:com.noirgym.app.summary: Log workouts, chase PRs, and grow your Fitness Score with every rep.
fdroid:com.noirgym.app.description:
Noir Gym is a premium, no-fluff workout log for lifters who want more than a spreadsheet. Every set you log builds a real training profile — from your rep history to a full Fitness Score that grows as you do.
💪 LOG YOUR TRAINING
Record any exercise with weight, sets, and reps in seconds. Pick a muscle group, save your set, and roll straight into a built-in rest timer (45s / 60s / 90s presets) so you never lose momentum between sets.
📈 WATCH YOUR PROGRESS
Pick any exercise and see its full weight curve over time. Noir Gym automatically tracks your personal records and celebrates the moment you set a new one.
🏆 FITNESS SCORE & LEVELS
A six-axis score — Consistency, Strength, Endurance, Habits, Progress, and Volume — calculated straight from your real training history and visualized on a radar chart. Earn points for every workout, every PR, and every streak day, and level up as your profile grows.
🔥 STREAKS & TRAINING SUMMARY
See your current streak, total workouts, total training volume, and exactly which muscle groups you've been hitting hardest, all summarized in one place.
🎯 BULK OR CUT
Set your current goal — Bulking or Cutting — to keep your training aligned with your phase.
📋 A FULL HISTORY, FILTERED YOUR WAY
Browse your complete workout log and filter it by month, year, or muscle group. Clean up old entries one at a time or in bulk whenever you want a fresh start.
📤 YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Everything is stored on your device — no account, no sign-up. Export your full training history whenever you like, and import it back on any device.
🌙 DESIGNED TO FEEL PREMIUM
A sleek dark "noir" interface (with a light mode if you prefer), full Arabic and English support with proper right-to-left layout, and an installable app that works offline, straight from your home screen.
Your consistency writes the score. Log your first set and start building yours. 💪

fdroid:com.tortel.syslog.name: SysLog
fdroid:com.tortel.syslog.description:
Records various log types and compresses them as a zip file.
The logs are saved in the application's private cache directory
named by the date and time.
You can access the zip files through the system document picker
- Select the SysLog app to view collected log zips.
Log types supported:
* Kernel logs (dmsg)
* Last kernel log (last_kmsg, if device supports it)
* Main log (Logcat)
* Modem log
* Event logs
* SELinux audit logs
To enable access to some logs (Logcat and Radio) to SysLog, you
will need to grant the READ_LOGS permision using a computer with
ADB.
From a command line with adb available, you can grant the READ_LOGS
permission via the following command:
adb shell pm grant com.tortel.syslog android.permission.READ_LOGS
This command tells the phone's package manager to grant the
READ_LOGS permission to SysLog.

fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.sepia.name: Sepia
fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.sepia.summary: Share images without oversharing. X-ray, redact, and prove the file is clean.
fdroid:io.github.munzzyy.sepia.description:
Photos and screenshots say more than you think: where you were, what phone
you own, sometimes a hidden copy of the uncropped shot or a video clip
appended by motion-photo mode.
Sepia is the step before you hit send:
* X-ray: see everything the file says about you, ranked by severity. GPS in
 plain words, the hidden thumbnail shown, trailing data called out.
* Redact: ink and pixelation burned into the pixels, plus crop. Where the device supports code
 detection, QR codes are found and offered for covering.
* Prove it: the export is re-encoded from scratch, then Sepia re-opens its
 own output and shows you what is (and is not) still inside.
Everything happens on your device. This app has no INTERNET permission: the
operating system will not let it open a connection, and you can check the
manifest instead of trusting a promise.
Runs on Android 9 and newer, with Android System WebView 108 or newer.
Android 9 has had no security fixes since January 2022, so on a phone that
old Sepia works, but the phone itself is easier to break into.
No accounts, no analytics, no dependencies. GPL licensed.

fdroid:org.secuso.privacyfriendlybattles.description:
With the Privacy Friendly Battleship app, you can play the popular game "Battleship" conveniently on your smartphone. The goal of the game is to sink all of your opponent's ships by taking turns "shooting" at the opponent's board.
The game offers two game modes:
- Player vs. Computer
- Player vs. Player
The player can choose between 5x5 and 10x10 board sizes and place their ships freely. The number of ships can be selected before the game. Ships of sizes 2 (submarines), 3 (destroyers), 4 (cruisers), and 5 (battleships) are possible.
What distinguishes Privacy Friendly Battleship from other similar apps?
1. No Permissions
Privacy Friendly Battleship does not require any permissions.
For comparison: The top ten similar apps available in the Google Play Store require an average of 6.1 permissions (as of November 2017). These include access to networks, the internet, and location data.
2. No intrusive ads
Many other free apps in the Google Play Store display intrusive ads, which, among other things, can shorten battery life and consume data.
The app belongs to the group of Privacy Friendly Apps developed by the SECUSO research group at the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology. More information at: https://secuso.org/pfa

fdroid:org.sufficientlysecure.keychain.name: OpenKeychain: Easy PGP
fdroid:org.sufficientlysecure.keychain.summary: Encrypt your Files and Communications. Compatible with the OpenPGP Standard.
fdroid:org.sufficientlysecure.keychain.description:
OpenKeychain helps you communicate more privately and securely. It uses encryption to ensure that your messages can be read only by the people you send them to, others can send you messages that only you can read, and these messages can be digitally signed so the people getting them are sure who sent them. OpenKeychain is based on the well established OpenPGP standard making encryption compatible across your devices and systems. For a list of compatible software for Windows, Mac OS, and other operating systems consult http://openpgp.org/software/.
Modern encryption is based on digital “keys”. OpenKeychain stores and manages your keys, and those of the people you communicate with, on your Android smartphone. It also helps you find others’ keys online, and exchange keys. But its most frequent use is in using those keys to encrypt and decrypt messages.
★ Integration with other Apps:
• K-9 Mail
• Conversations
• and many more…
★ Open Source: OpenKeychain is designed to be trustworthy. It’s Free Software with no secrets; anyone can examine and validate every bit of it (Source code available at https://github.com/open-keychain/open-keychain)
★ Independent Security Audit: The auditing company Cure53 performed an intensive security audit of OpenKeychain. The security experts summarize their final result with "[...] none of the spotted issues were considered to be of a critical severity in terms of security implications. The latter is a significant and impressive result for an app of this complexity and relevance."
★ Permissions: Because OpenKeychain is Free Software, anyone can validate that the permissions are indeed only required for the listed features.
• In-app purchases: Donate to the developers
• Identity: Pre-fill name and email addresses
• Contacts: Connect keys to your contacts (only offline)
• Photos/Media/Files: Import/export keys from SD card
• Camera: Scan QR Codes to add other people's keys
• Others: Internet permission to retrieve keys, NFC permission to use YubiKeys
Starting with Android 6, permissions are requested when required in-app!

fdroid:space.subread.app.name: SubRead
fdroid:space.subread.app.summary: Line an audiobook up with its ebook: subtitles and video, made on your device.
fdroid:space.subread.app.description:
SubRead lines an audiobook up with its ebook, sentence by sentence, and gives you subtitles with the time of each line. Read along while you listen: for language learners, and for anyone who wants text and voice together.
The words come from your book, not from a speech model. A small model only listens for where the narrator is; the text of each line is the book's own. Names, spelling and punctuation stay right.
WHAT IT MAKES
• Subtitles (.srt) - each line of the book with the time it is read. Made for Hoshi Reader's read-along, and they work in any player.
• Video + subtitles - an .mp4 of the book's cover over the audio, with the .srt beside it. It plays with subtitles in any video player, and you can upload it to YouTube. 720p and larger, 1 to 60 frames a second. The picture is still, so the video adds only about 60 MB to a 10-hour book.
WHAT IT TAKES
• Audio: m4b, m4a, mp3, opus, ogg, flac, wav
• Book: epub, plain text, Aozora Bunko zip
• Languages: Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Finnish, English, German, French, Italian, Chinese, Korean and more, or automatic detection
PRIVATE, AND YOURS
• All of the work is done on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
• No account, no ads, no tracking. The app asks for no permissions and does not use the network.
• Free, and open source (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/equwal/subread-android
GOOD TO KNOW
• A long book takes hours: about a third of the length of the audio on a mid-range device. Keep the app open while it works. If it is interrupted, Continue starts from where it was.
• Pages that nobody reads aloud (front matter, notes) are left out by themselves.
• The app needs a 64-bit ARM processor from about 2018 or later (ARMv8.2).
• You need the audiobook and the ebook of the same text. A different edition or translation gives poor results; the app tells you how much of the book it found.
In a hurry, or on an old phone? The same conversion runs in a browser at https://subread.space

Thanks to everyone for making MyRadar so successful, with over 50 million downloads!
MyRadar is a fast, powerful, easy-to-use weather app that displays animated weather radar around your current location and to quickly show what weather is coming your way. Just start the app; your location pops up with animated live radar, with radar loop lengths of up to two hours. This basic functionality provides the quickest way to get a snapshot of the weather on-the-go, and it's what has made MyRadar so successful over the years. Check your phone and get an instant assessment of the weather that will impact your day.
One of the most useful features in MyRadar is the ability to provide advanced rain alerts; our patent-pending process for predicting hyper-local rainfall is the most accurate in the industry. Instead of having to check the app all the time, MyRadar will send you an alert up to an hour in advance as to when the rain will arrive at your current location, down to the minute, including details on intensity and duration. These alerts can be a life saver when you're on-the-go and don't always have time to check the weather - our systems will proactively do the work for you and let you know in advance before the rain hits.
In addition to the live radar, MyRadar has an ever-increasing list of weather and environmentally-related data layers that you can overlay on top of the map; our animated winds layer shows a breathtaking visual representation of both surface winds and winds at the jetstream level; the frontal boundaries layer shows high and low pressure systems as well as frontal boundaries themselves; the earthquakes layer is a great way to stay on top of the latest reports on seismic activity, completely customizable as to severity and time; our hurricane layer allows users to stay on top of the latest tropical storm and hurricane activity throughout the world; the aviation layer overlays AIRMETs, SIGMETs and other aviation-related data, including the ability to track flights and display their IFR flight plans and paths, and the "wildfires" layer allows users to stay abreast of the latest fire activity around the United States.
MyRadar also has the ability to send weather and environmental alerts, including alerts from the National Weather Service, such as Tornado and Severe Weather alerts. A new feature introduced in this version of MyRadar includes the ability to receive alerts based off of Tropical Storm and Hurricane activity; you can configure the app to send you an alert any time a tropical storm or hurricane forms, or is upgraded or downgraded.
In addition to the free features of the app, additional upgrades are available, including real-time hurricane tracking - great for the start of hurricane season. The hurricane tracker provides additional data above and beyond the free version, including the cone of probability for tropical storm/hurricane forecast tracks, and it also includes a detailed synopsis from the National Hurricane Center. Weather forecast data, packaged as GRIB files, can be downloaded directly from the LuckGrib server cluster. Downloads are available via: a direct high speed internet connection, or through the Iridium GO! as well as through the RedPort Optimizer.
For sailors, LuckGrib offers a best-in-class, complete solution: industry leading visualization and ease of use, highly optimized weather data downloads via satellite, along with industry leading optimized weather routing and route analysis. Inshore sailors may not require satellite downloads, but will benefit from the rest of the system.
LuckGrib is unique among apps that were originally designed for sailors, in that the weather analysis tools are powerful enough to attract attention from meteorologitsts.
For sailors, meteorologists, and all weather enthusiasts, LuckGrib offers access to a wide range of high resolutions models, a number of global models, weather data at the surface, 850mb, 500mb and 250mb levels, parameters ranging from simple things such as wind, pressure and temperature, to more advanced quantities such as simulated radar, standard deviations, precipitable water, lightning, vertical vorticity, helicity and more. LuckGrib is a thoroughly modern and advanced GRIB viewer.
LuckGrib provides access to many weather and ocean models, including global models such as GFS and ECMWF along with many high resolution models, which vary according to the region you are interested in. In the USA, there is the HRRR, NAM, NBM and many others. In Europe there is Icon-EU, Arpège, Arome, the Danish DINI and others. There are several ocean current models, such as the global RTOFS and Mercator Ocean, along with regional higher resolution models such as OFS, NCOM, CMEMS and others.

Downloading data via satellite requires the Offshore Data in-app purchase. Access to the isochronal weather routing system requires an in-app purchase.

Never do the same workout twice. Bodyweight WorkoutRandomizer builds a fresh, balanced routine in seconds from the focus areas, difficulty and equipment you choose. No gear needed, though you can add what you have.
GENERATE A WORKOUT IN SECONDS Pick a goal (General Fitness, Fat Burn, Strength/Power or HIIT), tap the areas you want to train, and set your difficulty and available equipment. Generate draws a balanced session from moves that match, so every workout is different and you still hit what you came to work on.
YOUR TIMER, YOUR WAY The Timer tab controls how each session runs. Choose Standard, Pyramid, Repeating Blocks or an Add-On ladder, then set work and rest times and add an optional warm-up and cool-down matched to your focus areas. After you generate, Custom Timers let you change the time for any single exercise.
BUILD YOUR OWN OR DRAW FROM YOUR LIST Prefer to pick the moves? Swipe or long-press any exercise to add it to your list, then set Source to My List to run all of them in order or let the app draw a workout from them. Star favorites so they're always easy to find.
EXERCISE LIBRARY WITH VIDEO DEMOS Browse a large catalog of bodyweight moves, most with video demonstrations, and filter by focus area, difficulty and equipment. Add your own custom exercises too. Stream videos, download them for offline use, or turn them off once you know the moves.
STRETCH & RECOVERY Flip Generate to Stretch for guided sessions across five categories, from a quick cool-down to a full-body routine, with timed holds and demos.
LIVE STATS & APPLE WATCH Your heart rate, zone, calories, burn type and countdown sit right on the demo video, so you never have to look away to check your effort. Zones come straight from your Apple Watch, and iPhone and Watch stay in step through every exercise, rest, pause and skip. Pause or skip from your wrist, and completed workouts save to Apple Health as the right type: Mixed Cardio, Core or Flexibility.
SAVE, ORGANIZE & SHARE Save any workout or stretch you generate or build, name it, and file it in folders. Export a routine to a file to share it with a friend or move it to another device, and import routines from others.
TRAIN ANYWHERE At home, in a hotel room or at the park, all you need is a few square feet. Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac. On iPad and iPhone Duo, workouts go full screen with an Up Next preview and a progress bar.
Whether you're just starting out or want quick, varied training without a gym, Bodyweight WorkoutRandomizer keeps every session fresh.

fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.name: flexmark-java-util-format
fedora-packages:flexmark-java/flexmark-j.description: Flexmark-java is a Java CommonMark (spec 0.28) parser using the blocks first, inlines after Markdown parsing architecture. Its strengths are speed, flexibility, Markdown source element based AST with details of the source position down to individual characters of lexemes that make up the element and extensibility. The API allows granular control of the parsing process and is optimized for parsing with a large number of installed extensions. The parser and extensions come with plenty of options for parser behavior and HTML rendering variations. The end goal is to have the parser and renderer be able to mimic other parsers with great degree of accuracy. This is now partially complete with the implementation of Markdown Processor Emulation. This package contains format utility classes.

fedora-packages:fstrm/fstrm.name: fstrm

Has profiles features, so you can revert to known fingerprinting profile if some website breaks.
This extension is open source!
- WebGL
- Canvas
- Audio
- User Agent
- Fonts
- Battery
- Geolocation

firefox-addons:2633110.name: ductivityPRO: Become a Productivity Pro
firefox-addons:2633110.summary: A productivity extension for Firefox that helps you regulate yourself by taking control of the time you spend on the internet.
firefox-addons:2633110.description:
Allows you to set a timer for the amount of time you want to spend on a tab. Once that's over, the extension warps the page(tilting the web page and giving it a border) and sends you a notification. In order to enable the full functionality of the extension and customize it, click on the settings icon on the top right hand corner of the popup or the preferences tab in about:addons.
Features:
1. There are no preset times, you can set any time between 0 to 60 minutes.
2. If you're in full screen mode on YouTube or elsewhere it will automatically bring you out of it.
3. The amount of tilt of the webpage is fully customizable and can be changed from the preferences settings.
4. The width of the border is also fully customizable and can be changed from the preferences settings.
5. Even if you move between different websites in a tab the alarm will still ring and the page will still be warped.
6. You can see the amount of time left in your timer in the toolbar popup. 
7. If something changes and you need to spend more time on the page, clicking the "u" in the d(u)ctivityPRO popup will undo the warp.
8. You can clear alarms after they are set from the popup.
9. If you want to use it for work or simply for pomodoros you can set the tilt to 0 and the border to 0.
10. The extension can disable the polymer version of YouTube for videos. This is because with the new polymer version of youtube you can't go into full screen mode once the alarm rings. So if you're using this to curb your binge watching tendencies you can just leave polymer mode on. Otherwise you can disable it in the options menu. It doesn’t disable it for the main menu because it’s easier to navigate with the new polymer design and looks much better, it only disables polymer for the actual page with the video.
This extension does not store or collect any information about you. The tilt and border you set are stored locally. No information of any kind is transmitted to us.

firefox-addons:2805608.name: Smart Translator: Easy one click translations
firefox-addons:2805608.summary: Quickly translate selected, typed text or web pages using Google Translate.
firefox-addons:2805608.description:
One easy click to translate a text on the page. Select a text or click the 'Translator' icon. Translate any text in the pop-up by clicking the extension icon.
Overlay translate provides translation with a single click. Click on the icon near the selected text and get a translation within 1 second.
Features:
✰ One-click translation on any page
✰ Translate any text by the extension icon
✰ Translate the whole page

firefox-addons:2884828.name: Copy Video Frame
firefox-addons:2884828.summary: Capture the current picture of a video as an image. Copy it to the clipboard or look at it in a small window, from a right click, a keyboard shortcut or the toolbar button.
firefox-addons:2884828.description:
Capture the current picture of a video as an image. Copy it to the clipboard or look at it in a small window, from a right click, a keyboard shortcut or the toolbar button.
 Quick start 
 Hold Shift and right click a video. Holding Shift gets you the normal Firefox menu even on pages that show their own menu for the video.
 Choose "Copy Video Frame".
 The picture is captured, a short white flash and a shutter sound confirm it, and the image is ready:
 if you have allowed clipboard access, it is copied to the clipboard as an image, ready to paste
 otherwise it opens in a small window. Right click the image there to copy or save it.
 Three ways to capture 
 Right click menu : Shift and right click the video, then "Copy Video Frame". This works for videos in embedded frames too.
 Keyboard shortcut : press Alt+Shift+V to capture the video under the mouse. If the mouse is not over a video, the first video on the page is used. You can change the keys in the Add-ons Manager (Manage Extension Shortcuts).
 Toolbar button : click it to capture the first video that is visible in the tab. This is handy when you would rather not hover over the video.
The shortcut and the toolbar button only find videos in the page itself, not in embedded frames. Use the right click menu for videos inside frames.
If no video is found, a small window explains what went wrong.
 Where the image goes 
 Clipboard : needs the optional permission to put data into the clipboard. Allow it in the Add-ons Manager on the Permissions tab of this add-on. After that, every capture is copied as an image right away.
 Window : without the permission, the image opens in a small window that fits the video, up to 90 percent of your screen. The picture scales down to fit.
 How the picture is taken 
 Directly from the video : the default. The current frame is read from the video in its original size, so it is sharp. It works even if the video is scrolled out of view. Anything drawn on top of the video, such as subtitles or buttons of a custom player, is not part of the picture.
 Screenshot of the video : used automatically for protected (DRM) videos and other videos that do not allow reading their frames. The visible area of the video is captured from the screen, cropped to the video. Everything visible on top of it, including subtitles, is part of the picture. The video has to be on screen for this.
The controls of the video are hidden for a moment during the capture, so that they do not end up in the picture, and are brought back right after.
 Options 
The options page opens once after the installation and later from the add-on preferences. It has a "How to use" section and these settings, which are saved right away:
 Shutter sound : switch the sound on or off, test it, upload your own sound (MP3, WAV or OGG, up to 500 KB) or go back to the built-in sound.
 Always use screenshot capture : always use the screenshot method, even for ordinary videos. Use it to get subtitles and other overlays in your pictures. The video must be on screen.
 Permissions and privacy 
 menus: add "Copy Video Frame" to the right click menu of videos.
 activeTab: read the video in the tab you use the add-on on, and take the screenshot of the tab.
 storage: remember the sound and capture settings.
 clipboardWrite (optional): copy the image to the clipboard.
The add-on does not collect or transmit any data. The pictures stay on your computer.

firefox-addons:1014629.name: YouTube Screenshot Button
firefox-addons:1014629.summary: Take screenshots from YouTube Videos & YouTube Shorts. The addon adds screenshot button & also enables Shift+A shortcut.
firefox-addons:1014629.description:
This add-on adds extra button on Youtube player to download the screenshot of video & shorts.
 Addon also enables Shift+A shortcut to take screenshot.
 From the add-on preferences you can select whether screenshot should be saved as PNG or JPEG.
 From the add-on preferences you can select whether you want screenshot to be downloaded or to be copied to clipboard.
 Enjoy seamless experience from this very light weight add-on very.
 This add-on is completely safe to use.
 This is an open source project, find the code on https://github.com/gurumukhi/youtube-screenshot .

firefox-addons:2943715.name: Downloader for Reddit - RedditGrab
firefox-addons:2943715.summary: Grab images and videos from Reddit posts (Redgifs included). Supports individual downloads and automated mass downloading.
firefox-addons:2943715.description:
Features
 Individual post downloads via injected buttons
 Mass downloads with auto-scrolling
 Customizable download settings and folder organization
 Title overlay on images and videos
 Image and video processing
 No analytics or data collection
Step 1: Basic Usage
 Go to Reddit : Navigate to any Reddit page ( reddit.com )
 Individual Downloads : Look for blue "Download" buttons on posts and click them
 Mass Downloads : Click the RedditGrab extension icon to open the sidebar panel
Step 2: Configure Settings (Optional)
 Download Folder : Set where files are saved (default: Downloads/Reddit Downloads)
 Filename Pattern : Customize file names (supports {subreddit}, {timestamp}, {filename})
 Title Overlay : Enable to add post titles to images/videos
Step 3: Start Downloading
 Single Post : Click any blue "Download" button
 All Posts : Open sidebar → Click "Start Mass Download" → Extension auto-scrolls and downloads everything

firefox-addons:2828898.name: KPN Password Manager
firefox-addons:2828898.summary: KPN Password Manager is een wachtwoordmanager die jou helpt om veilig, snel en gemakkelijk overal in te loggen.
firefox-addons:2828898.description:
Bescherm jouw bedrijf 
Bespaar tijd, werk veiliger en maak inloggen gemakkelijk. Met de KPN Password Manager genereer, beheer, en auto-fill je veilig jouw wachtwoorden overal en op elk device. Stel jouw bedrijf in staat om een sterk wachtwoordbeleid te hanteren, risico’s te beperken en jouw bedrijfscontinuïteit beter te beschermen. 
 Moeiteloos in gebruik 
Gebruikers beschermen en gebruiken moeiteloos zakelijke inloggegevens en overige gevoelige informatie. Wachtwoorden hoeven niet meer zelf bedacht, onthouden of opgezocht te worden. Je medewerkers besparen tijd door het gebruik van de KPN Password Manager en worden productiever. Ze zijn geen tijd meer kwijt aan het beheer of herstel van inloggegevens. Bestaande wachtwoorden kunnen ook zonder moeite geïmporteerd worden zodat je alles veilig op 1 plek hebt. Krijg naadloos en veilig toegang tot de eigen inloggegevens door het gebruik van Single Sign-On (SSO) en Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). De KPN Password Manager doet het werk, met jouw privacy en veiligheid als hoogste prioriteit. 
 Data privacy & veiligheid 
Alle data wordt veilig, met end-to-end encryption, gesynchroniseerd naar de cloud van een Nederlands datacenter. Jouw privacy en de veiligheid van jouw data staan centraal. Alleen jij als gebruiker hebt overal veilig toegang tot jouw actuele versleutelde gegevens. Op elke locatie, via elke browser, of elk apparaat. Deze gegevens blijven verder voor iedereen geheim, dus ook voor ons. Alle gegevens worden versleuteld met AES-GCM en RSA-2048 keys.
 Nederlandse KPN dienst 
De KPN Password Manager is een Nederlandse dienst die is ontwikkeld door KPN in samenwerking met een partner die gespecialiseerd is in encryptie en security.
 Met de KPN Password Manager krijg je: 
• Moeiteloos inloggen: altijd in 1x snel en makkelijk overal inloggen met een druk op de knop.
• Overal toegang: op elke locatie, via elke browser, of elk apparaat – Windows, Mac, iOS, Android.
• Gecentraliseerde veilige opslag: bewaar en beheer al jouw inloggegevens & overige gevoelige informatie veilig op 1 plek
• Synchronisatie tussen je apparaten: altijd de meest actuele gegevens, op al je verbonden apparaten 
• Naadloze integratie met SSO: naadloos toegang tot eigen gegevens via de SSO integratie met KPN Grip
• Privacy: niemand, behalve jijzelf, heeft toegang tot jouw gegevens. Wij kunnen jouw gegevens ook nooit inzien, gebruiken, delen, of verkopen
• Dataopslag in Nederland: alle data wordt enkel in Nederland opgeslagen, onder de strenge Nederlandse en EU privacy- en datawetgeving
• Veilig informatie delen: houd controle over het makkelijk en versleuteld delen van gevoelige gegevens met collega’s 
• Gecentraliseerd gebruikersbeheer: via KPN Grip is gebruikersbeheer extra simpel en overzichtelijk
• Check op potentiële risico’s: check al jouw inloggegevens direct op risico’s en gelekte wachtwoorden 
• Compliance standaarden: de dienst voldoet aan de GDPR, SOC2, eIDAS-Regulation [(EU)910/2014], … standaarden en regulatie 
• Versleuteling van gegevens op basis van AES-GCM en RSA-2048 keys
Web omgeving: https://passwordmanager.kpn.com

bluejetty:00026151:ios.description:
Powerful & Easy XLSX Editing at your fingertips:
Tired of bulky spreadsheet software that limits your mobility? Introducing XLSX Sheets, your all-in-one mobile solution for creating, editing, and managing Excel-friendly Spreadsheets and Smartsheets with unmatched ease and efficiency.
Effortlessly manage data at your fingertips, anywhere, anytime:
• Edit with precision: Utilize a comprehensive suite of editing tools for Excel-compatible spreadsheet control. Cut, copy, paste, format cells, and apply Excel-compatible formulas seamlessly.
• Formula mastery made easy: Access a library of easy-to-advanced Excel compatible functions and receive real-time formula suggestions as you type, ensuring error-free calculations.
• Visualize your success: Effortlessly create and manipulate charts and graphs in both spreadsheet and Smartsheet files, gaining clear insights from your data.
• Real-time sheet collaboration: Work seamlessly with colleagues or classmates by sharing spreadsheets and xls through popular cloud services like Google Drive, Dropbox, and OneDrive.
Your perfect spreadsheet companion:
• Analyze advanced data: Leverage powerful tools to sort, filter, and create pivot tables, extracting valuable insights from your sheets.
• Streamlined compatible workflows: Utilize Excel-compatible templates for tasks like budgeting, to-do lists, accounting, and financial analysis, saving you valuable time and effort.
• Seamless data exchange: Import data from various sources, including CSV files, web tables, and other XLS files, ensuring compatibility across platforms. Export or convert your sheet to formats like PDF, CSV, or XLS for maximum flexibility.
Sheets tailored for your unique needs:
• Personalize your experience: Choose from customizable themes, cell styles, and conditional formatting options to make your spreadsheets visually appealing and functional.
• Work offline, uninterrupted: Continue working on your spreadsheets even without an internet connection. Offline sheet access ensures you have control over your data, wherever you are.
• Customer support: Enjoy regular xls updates and top-notch customer support to keep your editing experience smooth and efficient.
Whether you are a business professional, student, or simply someone who needs to manage data on the go, XLSX Sheets is the perfect tool for you. Download it today and experience the power of mobile spreadsheets!
Key features:
• Edit, create, and manage XLS sheets and Smartsheets
• Powerful excel compatible formula builder with real-time suggestions
• Comprehensive data visualization tools (charts, graphs & pivots)
• Real-time spreadsheet collaboration through cloud integration
• Advanced data analysis features (sort, filter, pivot tables, budget calculations)
• Modern templates for various tasks (budgeting, accounting, reporting, etc.)
• Import and export data in various formats (CSV, PDF, XLS)
• Customizable themes, cell styles, and formatting options
• Offline spreadsheet access for uninterrupted work
• Regular updates and dedicated customer support
Download XLSX Sheets today and start working smarter, not harder!
Weekly/Monthly/Yearly subscriptions available. Choose the plan that best suits your needs. Cancel anytime.
Subscription will be charged to your credit card through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription in the Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of use - https://sites.google.com/a1apps.co/tc-xlsx-sheets-ios/home
Any feedback is welcomed at p3@a1apps.helpscoutapp.com

bluejetty:00029149:ios.description:
PG Reader
Description
Stay up-to-date with all things Pittsburgh – through the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette’s PG Reader app. You’ll get up-to-the-minute breaking local and regional news directly from the Post-Gazette.
The PG Reader app gives you a direct feed of every local and regional news and lifestyle story that the Post-Gazette writes -- as soon as it's published! You'll get breaking news, business, politics, local news and more.
In addition, with the PG Reader App you can share the news via e-mail or save it to your favorites. 
Unlimited access to this app can be purchased through the Post-Gazette’s digital subscription package. Non-subscribers may view a limited number of items every month.
Features:
- Live feed of all local, regional, political and lifestyle, college and high schools sports articles directly from the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette
- Browse articles by content sections
- Save articles to your "Favorites” section to view at a later date
- E-mail an article to a friend
- Share article on Facebook or Twitter

bluejetty:00019120:ios.name: H.I.D.E. - Hide or Seek Online
bluejetty:00019120:ios.summary:
Dive into a world of hide-and-seek and survival in our online game! An exciting multiplayer first-person shooter with engaging role-playing mechanics. Explore a vibrant pixel world with unique maps!
In HIDE, everyone chooses their role. Yo
bluejetty:00019120:ios.description:
Dive into a world of hide-and-seek and survival in our online game! An exciting multiplayer first-person shooter with engaging role-playing mechanics. Explore a vibrant pixel world with unique maps!
In HIDE, everyone chooses their role. You will need to hide from the Hunters as Props. You can also seek Props while playing as a Hunter.
Become a cunning prop and cleverly hide from the hunters. Scatter objects around the map to create confusing traps. Transform into a hunter and search for your enemies. Upgrade your abilities to become even more agile and elusive. Survive and conquer in online hide-and-seek!
Battle with friends and players from all over the world in multiplayer online mode. Develop your skills and become a true master of hiding. Participate in online competitions and emerge victorious.
=> Download now. HIDE will become your favorite pixel survival shooter!
What awaits you in this amazing world?
- Play in the "Props vs. Hunters" mode. Use props to hide and outsmart your enemies!
- Upgrade your characters to win in this multiplayer online survival game. A multitude of skins and weapons. A unique achievement system.
- An engaging pixel shooter. Every move could be decisive. Only the bravest and smartest can emerge victorious.
- This unique 3D game in the Prop Hunt genre combines elements of Among Us, Squid Game, Hide Online, and Garry's Mod Prop Hunt (gmod).
- Join us and compete with friends and other players in this dynamic adventure! Notice the smallest details, plan your moves, and show who the true master of hiding is.
=> Download now. Experience incredible adventures in the world of hiding and survival online!
If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to write to us at: hide_help@mail.ru.

Accounts
- Check your latest account balance and search recent transactions by date, amount, or check number.
Bill Pay

Transfers
- Easily transfer cash between your Sabine State Bank accounts.
Locations

bluejetty:00015444:ios.name: Math Games for Kids: Addition
bluejetty:00015444:ios.summary: Math Land is an educational video game for children and adults. With it they will learn and obtain reinforcement for the main mathematical operations—addition, subtraction, multiplication, sorting from higher to lower, division, and negativ
bluejetty:00015444:ios.description:
Math Land is an educational video game for children and adults. With it they will learn and obtain reinforcement for the main mathematical operations—addition, subtraction, multiplication, sorting from higher to lower, division, and negative numbers.
It is not just a math app—it's a real educational adventure!
GAME PLOT
An evil pirate, Max, has stolen the sacred gems and has cursed the islands filling them with obstacles and traps. Help Ray, our pirate, find the gems and restore the natural order of things. Navigate your ship through the seas to get them, but remember: you will need a spyglass to discover new islands.
Solve fun math games to get them: addition, subtraction, numbering, multiplication tables, and division. The islanders need you!
EVERY ISLAND IS AN ADVENTURE
Have fun with over 25 levels and negotiate all kinds of obstacles in order to get to the chest that holds the gem. It will be a real adventure—you'll have to deal with quicksand, bewitched parrots, volcanoes with lava, puzzle games, magic doors, funny carnivorous plants, etc. It will surprise you!
EDUCATIONAL CONTENT
For children aged 5-6:
* Learning to add and subtract with very small numbers and amounts (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 10).
* Reinforcing mental arithmetic with already learned additions and subtractions.
For children aged 7-8:
* Learning to add and subtract with larger numbers and amounts (1 to 20).
* Getting started on learning multiplication tables (the learning of multiplication tables will be done gradually in order to track the children's progress).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 50).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 50).
* Developing mental arithmetic with educational games based on addition, subtraction, and multiplication tables.
For children aged 9+ and adults:
* More complex additions and subtractions, teaching mental association of numbers with different arithmetic strategies (adding and subtracting).
* Reinforcing the learning of all multiplication tables (multiplications).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower and vice versa, including negative numbers.
* Learning mathematical operations with negative numbers.
* Mental division.
* Developing advanced mental arithmetic with additions, subtractions, multiplications, and divisions.
WE ARE DIDACTOONS
Our development studio, Didactoons, has extensive experience in developing educational apps and games that combine learning and fun. Proof of this is the success of our other three apps and their—at the moment—over three million downloads worldwide:
* Dino Tim: An educational video game for learning shapes, numbers, and getting started on addition and subtraction.
* Monster Numbers: A real educational adventure that blends pure arcade fun and learning mathematics.
So don't miss it—download the free educational game Math Land!
SOCIAL MEDIA
Web: http://mathlandgame.com/
Google Plus: https://plus.google.com/+MathLandApp
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mathlandgame.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/MathLandGame
OVERVIEW
Company: Didactoons
Educational video game: Math Land
Recommended age: children aged 5+ and adults

listings.description:
Math Land is an educational video game for children and adults. With it they will learn and obtain reinforcement for the main mathematical operations—addition, subtraction, multiplication, sorting from higher to lower, division, and negative numbers.

It is not just a math app—it's a real educational adventure!

GAME PLOT

An evil pirate, Max, has stolen the sacred gems and has cursed the islands filling them with obstacles and traps. Help Ray, our pirate, find the gems and restore the natural order of things. Navigate your ship through the seas to get them, but remember: you will need a spyglass to discover new islands.
Solve fun math games to get them: addition, subtraction, numbering, multiplication tables, and division. The islanders need you!

EVERY ISLAND IS AN ADVENTURE

Have fun with over 25 levels and negotiate all kinds of obstacles in order to get to the chest that holds the gem. It will be a real adventure—you'll have to deal with quicksand, bewitched parrots, volcanoes with lava, puzzle games, magic doors, funny carnivorous plants, etc. It will surprise you!

EDUCATIONAL CONTENT

For children aged 5-6:
* Learning to add and subtract with very small numbers and amounts (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 10).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 10).
* Reinforcing mental arithmetic with already learned additions and subtractions.

For children aged 7-8:
* Learning to add and subtract with larger numbers and amounts (1 to 20).
* Getting started on learning multiplication tables (the learning of multiplication tables will be done gradually in order to track the children's progress).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower (1 to 50).
* Sorting numbers from lower to higher (1 to 50).
* Developing mental arithmetic with educational games based on addition, subtraction, and multiplication tables.

For children aged 9+ and adults:
* More complex additions and subtractions, teaching mental association of numbers with different arithmetic strategies (adding and subtracting).
* Reinforcing the learning of all multiplication tables (multiplications).
* Sorting numbers from higher to lower and vice versa, including negative numbers.
* Learning mathematical operations with negative numbers.
* Mental division.
* Developing advanced mental arithmetic with additions, subtractions, multiplications, and divisions.

WE ARE DIDACTOONS

Our development studio, Didactoons, has extensive experience in developing educational apps and games that combine learning and fun. Proof of this is the success of our other three apps and their—at the moment—over three million downloads worldwide:

* Dino Tim: An educational video game for learning shapes, numbers, and getting started on addition and subtraction.

* Monster Numbers: A real educational adventure that blends pure arcade fun and learning mathematics.

So don't miss it—download the free educational game Math Land!

SOCIAL MEDIA

Web: http://mathlandgame.com/
Google Plus: https://plus.google.com/+MathLandApp
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/mathlandgame.com/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/MathLandGame

OVERVIEW

Company: Didactoons
Educational video game: Math Land
Recommended age: children aged 5+ and adults

bluejetty:00023216:ios.description:
Build Your Perfect Tower of Defense 
The Tower – Idle Tower Defense game is here. Build the perfect tower of defense with our incremental tower defense game where you will control a single tower, and make permanent upgrades to it. 
1. Defend your tower
Fight off waves of enemies and defend your tower, making tactical decisions to stand strong against the attackers. Experience an intense incremental tower defense game with ever-evolving strategies.
2. Permanent upgrades
Unlock powerful upgrades to your tower, allowing you to make permanent, game-changing improvements. Choose the best strategies for each battle – and for the big picture.
3. More than meets the eye
The Tower – Idle Tower Defense offers more than a classic tower defense game. Unlock new areas, defeat powerful bosses, and explore a world of tactical possibilities. More than meets the eye! Idle games are fun and we want to give you the most exciting experience you can have!
The Tower – Idle Tower Defense features:
• Addicting simplistic tower defense gameplay
• An insane number of upgrades to choose from
• Invest your valuable coins to permanently power up your tower in the workshop
• Research new upgrades to unlock new parts of the game
• Continue to unlock new research while idle or playing active
• Unlock and manage your card collection to provide your tower with massive bonuses
• Compete in live tournaments against other players to unlock ultimate weapons
Will your perfect tower stand the test of time in this new idle tower defense game?
Take on the challenge of conquering the Tower in this unique incremental tower defense game. Build your own perfect tower, upgrade it, and defend it until its destruction. Prove your tactical skills in this intense game! Idle games are fun!
IGRS Rating: 13+

Address Labels takes care of fitting the text/image to the label size. You just supply the contents and select label type - AddressLabels does the rest.
Compatible with the mac app via Cloud syncing.
Excellent for organising Christmas card or other mailing lists. No more forgetting to send a card – use your list year after year.
No. 1 iPad Utilities App last Christmas on USA and UK stores.
Most Avery label sheet types supported.
Supports Brother label printers (wifi).
Supports some Dymo LabelWriters though also requires 3rd party software (see website).
Prints to wide variety of envelopes - even custom sizes. Note: whilst working on most printers, it is not guaranteed to work on all printers.
Print USPS IM barcodes for USA addresses.
AddressLabels remembers the settings, making the next job even easier.
Import names from Contacts, spreadsheet csv files or type manually.
Personalize labels with image/photo e.g. Christmas icon
Create Return address labels.
Sort on First/Last Names, post/zip code, manually or Birthday (really handy for Birthday List)
The zip sort lets you target your mailings to specific neighbourhoods and can be especially helpful in the USA allowing you to get the lowest possible postal rates for bulk mail.
Create simple Custom labels e.g. for produce labels, storage boxes etc.
Record when cards have been written, mailed, hand-delivered or sent as eCards, and number of replies.
Number of stamps required displayed. 
Print directly from your device via Airprint-enabled printer.
Share - e.g. email or airdrop list.
Export to csv.
Store extra info e.g. children names etc.
Multiple uses - Christmas, Thanksgiving, Birthdays, Weddings, Baby Showers, storage jars, file labels etc. - use your imagination.
Lists sync with other iOS devices and Mac (iOS 13 or later). 
Check person’s history e.g. to see when they last sent you a card.
Use “alias” e.g. import “John Smith” from Contacts, but display and print “The Smiths” etc.
Use person's nickname/company for label/envelope
****************************************************************
Instructions on using the app at https://ios.addresslabels.app
Great support available - support@ios.addresslabels.app
***************************************************************
"This app, however, is nothing short of brilliant, easy to use and printing sensible labels."
"This app certainly takes the pain out of producing your Christmas and other lists. A lot of thought has gone into this truly excellent product."
"This is a superb program and does what it says simply and efficiently. The developer responds promptly to suggestions. Importing Contacts works well and changes are instantly carried through. My cards have never been sent out so early!"
"I love how this app has streamlined addressing my Christmas cards!! Thank you!!"
"AddressLabels delivers an extremely effective way to manage card lists which means the ability to easily compose lists from your Contacts, get the labels printed, and keep track of cards received and sent! Add the ability to manually enter list members, assign nicknames, select from multiple addresses, intelligent handling the country portion of the address, accommodate a large range of label types, AirPrint directly or produce a PDF of the labels, clone new lists from existing lists, all wrapped in a visually pleasing interface. Winner!"
"I hate addressing my Christmas cards. This app made it very easy to make labels. I don't have a printer that works with my iPad yet, so I really appreciated having the capability to send them as a PDF to my email address. The app is awesome..."
“Just what you need at this time of year - a reliable self updating list to speed up sending out cards. This is the 3rd or 4th year I've used it and it just gets better and better.”
“After years of tearing my hair out trying to get labels out of my iphone/iPad/iMac combo, an app that actually does what it promised!”

bluejetty:00037328:ios.summary:
Introducing the latest release of the OpenKey Guest mobile app! Access hotel rooms worldwide with a secure and convenient digital key directly on your smartphone.
With the OpenKey app, you can enjoy the following features:
- Instant Room
bluejetty:00037328:ios.description:
Introducing the latest release of the OpenKey Guest mobile app! Access hotel rooms worldwide with a secure and convenient digital key directly on your smartphone.
With the OpenKey app, you can enjoy the following features:
- Instant Room Access: Easily unlock your guest room with a simple touch of a button. No more fumbling with keycards or waiting in line at the front desk.
- Key Sharing: Share your digital key with up to 4 other guests, making it easier for your travel companions to access the room.
- Contact Hotel: Contact the hotel operations team for any additional needs during your stay, like extra pillows or towels, potential reservation details, and questions that may arise.
- Check-Out Details: View your check-out date and time on the mobile key, helping you stay organized and plan your departure effortlessly.
- Room Number on Mobile Key: Say goodbye to the hassle of carrying a keycard jacket. Your room number is conveniently displayed on the mobile key, allowing for a streamlined and hassle-free experience.
- Hotel Exploration: Discover hotel amenities, dining options, and other features through the app. Get a comprehensive overview of everything your hotel has to offer.
- Check-Out Request: Send a check-out request directly from your mobile key screen. Simplify the check-out process and save valuable time.

bluejetty:00015301:ios.name: Yard Planner
bluejetty:00015301:ios.summary:
YARD PLANNER is a simple drag-and-drop 2D landscape design app with all the tools you need to mock up your property, create new designs, and share them with friends and family.
YARD PLANNER is ideal for homeowners who want to try out fresh
bluejetty:00015301:ios.description:
YARD PLANNER is a simple drag-and-drop 2D landscape design app with all the tools you need to mock up your property, create new designs, and share them with friends and family.
YARD PLANNER is ideal for homeowners who want to try out fresh ideas for their yard. Useful for landscape professionals to share designs with clients and contractors. Also perfect for children and adults alike to exercise their imagination and creativity!
Use YARD PLANNER to select and place over 800 beautiful hand-drawn elements including trees, gardens, pools, patios, hammocks, driveways, houses and sheds, solar panels, and just about anything you might want for your property–even parties and weddings!
Features include:
• Sample designs to inspire or get you started
• Simple drag-and-drop functionality
• 34 palettes (800+ hand-drawn elements) to create your landscape design layout
• Resize, Rotate, Undo/Redo, Duplicate, Flip, Group
• Rotate elements with “Snap to 90” or turn off to rotate more precisely
• Snap to grid (elements stick to a re-sizeable grid of guidelines, turn on/off in Settings)
• Rulers (visible at edges of design; zoom in to the single unit; user selects feet/meters; can be turned on/off)
• Choose from 15 different background colors
• Sketch Tool (allows users to draw garden beds and other free-form shapes with an eraser and brushes of different colors, widths and opacity)
• Map Tool (This highly accurate mapping tool based on Google Maps allows you to drop pins at the corners of your property and import the map image with measurements into the app as a background.)
• North arrow (appears with Map Tool)
• Site Analysis palettes to mark the locations of your site’s utilities and light and moisture conditions
• Notes (allows users to tag elements in their designs with typed comments or descriptions)
• Light/Dark mode (changes Note tags and North arrow from white to black for visibility against light backgrounds.)
• Animated Figures (a palette of animated elements—a person, dog, cat, bird, and car—that move through your design on a looped or repeating path, adjustable speed, play and stop animation)
• Import a Photo as a background (useful for importing a digital image of your property plan)
• Create different Layers of elements in your design. Add, delete, rename layers, make each layer visible/invisible, lock/unlock for editing, and reorder layer position.
• In-app step-by-step guide to creating your Property Plan.
• Designs automatically save to the app’s Saved Designs gallery
• Share designs on social media
• Email an editable design so friends can edit one another’s designs and email them back and forth
***As featured in The New York Times, Fox News, USA Today, Gardenista, and more.
“Home Outside allows you to create intricate and varied landscapes…And when you’re finished designing your yard or indulging in a little dreamscaping, you can email results to friend.” –Kate Murphy, The New York Times
“The app gives you drag and drop tools to create a garden design idiosyncratic to your garden [and] allows you to choose hardscape materials, design paths and patios, and arrange furniture in your outdoor space.” –Dalilah Arja, Gardenista
“I can’t imagine a designer who wouldn’t want to have this on their phone or tablet. I’ve tried this app … it’s a great tool for a ‘quickie’ design that you can show clients … and then refine as you like.” –Jane Berger, Garden Design Online

bluejetty:00029795:ios.name: Verizon Call Filter
bluejetty:00029795:ios.summary:
Verizon Call Filter takes the guesswork out of answering your phone, with features that screen and automatically block incoming spam calls.
With Call Filter, you can:
• Identify suspected spam calls with alerts. 
• Automatically block spa
bluejetty:00029795:ios.description:
Verizon Call Filter takes the guesswork out of answering your phone, with features that screen and automatically block incoming spam calls.
With Call Filter, you can:
• Identify suspected spam calls with alerts. 
• Automatically block spam based on their risk level and send them to voicemail (Call Filter automatically blocks high-risk callers).
• Report phone numbers as spam.
• Use filters to block other unwanted callers, such as robocalls.
• Adjust spam filter settings any time.
For added security, upgrade to Call Filter Plus*. Features such as Caller ID and blocking neighborhoods give you even more control over incoming calls.
Download Verizon Call Filter and start answering calls with confidence.
*Eligible customers get a 15-day trial for Call Filter Plus. At the end of the trial, customers can choose to subscribe to Call Filter Plus at $3.99 per month, per line. If no action is taken, customers will be auto enrolled in the free version of Call Filter. Accounts with 3 or more eligible lines can subscribe to Call Filter Plus (Multi-line) for $10.99/mo by logging in to My Verizon. The spam filter will be automatically set to block high-risk spam callers, but you can change your block settings at any time. Data charges apply.
Verizon's Call Filter App requires a Verizon standard monthly account on an eligible device.
Please reference https://www.vzw.com/support/how-to-use-call-filter/ and https://www.vzw.com/support/call-filter-faqs/ for step-by-step instructions on how to use the app

bluejetty:00019597:ios.name: Angry Birds Journey
bluejetty:00019597:ios.summary:
Join Red and his friends on a slingshot adventure through changing seasons full of fun, challenging levels, and delightful destruction! 
Let the birds fly! Go after the piggies, topple their towers, and rescue the Hatchlings in Angry Birds
bluejetty:00019597:ios.description:
Join Red and his friends on a slingshot adventure through changing seasons full of fun, challenging levels, and delightful destruction! 
Let the birds fly! Go after the piggies, topple their towers, and rescue the Hatchlings in Angry Birds Journey, a modern take on a slingshot game.
Solve the ever-changing puzzles with quick wits and true aim, be rewarded with season and event tokens, and use them to claim amazing rewards that give your journey a boost! 
Relax and unwind with the most fun and laid-back Angry Birds game yet!
Features
- Pick up and play anytime, anywhere! No need to hurry, just enjoy the ride! 
- Solve fun and relaxing slingshot puzzles! No pressure, just aim and shoot! 
- Play through hundreds of levels that range from easy to extreme – for everyone to enjoy! No matter your skill level, you’ll have a blast! 
- New levels are added every week! More surprises, more excitement! 
- Complete levels, collect season and event tokens, and win great rewards! You never know what you’ll find next! 
- Play with all the classic Angry Birds characters and NEW ones! Meet Chuck, the yellow bird with a super speed boost! 
- Discover and explore intriguing ever-changing seasons! From sunny beaches to snowy mountains, from spooky forests to festive cities, there’s always something new to see! 
Need some help? Visit our support pages, or send us a message at support@rovio.com
Like us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/angrybirdsjourney
Angry Birds Journey is completely free to play, but there are optional in-app purchases available.
Join the Journey!
----------------------------------------

Please note that the game may not function properly if you do not have the newest version installed. If you have not installed the latest update, Rovio will not be responsible for the game failing to function as expected.
When playing this game, Rovio will offset the carbon footprint caused by the device’s energy consumption.
Terms of Use: https://www.rovio.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.rovio.com/privacy

FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!

TRY IT FREE, THEN UNLOCK THE FULL ADVENTURE FROM WITHIN THE GAME!
The Secret Order 2: Masked Intent is a suspenseful adventure with historical elements based on the theme of the conflict between good and evil.
The daughter of the Master of the Order of the Griffins receives an alarming call. She is the only person who can stop the new member of the high council – the Secret Five – from destroying the Order. The organisation has guarded the world for centuries, but recent events have brought it to the verge of ruin. Embark on an epic journey full of magical items, forbidden mysteries, and time travel. Restore the order of the world and make amends for the sins of the past. Learn the secrets of forgotten artefacts, travel to the 17th century, earn the trust of the spectres imprisoned on a mysterious island, and discover the seat of the Clan of the Dragon, whose only mission is to thwart the efforts of the Order and to spread chaos.
Will the two powerful artefacts be returned to their rightful places and will the world be saved from destruction? Will the Master's daughter live up to the task?
• Find over 260 items in 15 hidden object scenes!
• Explore 90 stunning locations!
• Complete over 30 various minigames!
• Earn 25 challenging achievements!
• High-end, immersive gameplay, optimized for tablets and phones!

Ward off boredom and welcome tranquility playing t
bluejetty:00017452:ios.description:
Ever wish for a game that not only works your mind but also helps calm it? Word Bliss is the ticket for your brain to go on a fun yet peaceful journey while getting better at your wordplay!
Ward off boredom and welcome tranquility playing this classic word link game that will test your puzzle solving skills, vocabulary, and spelling. And with serene backgrounds showcasing Planet Earth, your state of Zen will never be in jeopardy!
Starting with curiosity, play through these wonderful feelings, while also adding to your vocabulary word count. As you move up the levels, each picture path will match the emotion you are on.
Not as difficult as kakuro and much more interesting than any word link game out there, Word Bliss is the perfect game to put your mind at ease after a long day. Sit back, put your feet up and give your mind the refreshment it needs by forming word after word up and down the board.
How to Play:
As simple as it gets. Swipe the letters to find hidden words.
Game Features:
PLAY WHEREVER, WHENEVER - Why solve the words with your friends when you can do it all by yourself offline, without Wifi or the Internet!
FREE TO PLAY – Get this word link game for FREE and put your word game skills to the test
EASY TO LEARN, HARD TO MASTER – Starting with 2 letter words and going all the way to 7 letters, it gets your brain working hard
BOOST YOUR VOCABULARY – Go on a word finding spree and raise your vocabulary game
DAILY BONUS CALENDAR - Who doesn’t love a good mystery? Play and earn amazing rewards every day!
HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT - If you get stuck at any level, use Shuffle or Hints to help yourself out!
PLAY ACROSS DEVICES – Simply login using Facebook to sync your game progress and continue playing on any device
So, are you up for some awesome wordplay? Get it now!

bluejetty:00027428:ios.description:
Predator Pro is a professional-grade predator hunting toolkit designed to specifically work with the Bullet HP electronic call. Coyote hunters, fox hunters, and really anyone hunting predators of any kind will see the effectiveness of predator hunting with the Predator Pro mobile app.
Predator Pro comes equipped with 50 sounds for FREE!
*New Predator Sound Pack available with more coyote, bobcat, and raccoon sounds in the latest version. 
Predator Pro by Convergent Hunting is designed to work in conjunction with the “Bullet HP” (special purpose Bluetooth controlled speaker/decoy) to help you get professional predator calling results. Together, the Convergent Hunting apps and Convergent Bullet HP, combine the latest in technology to provide you with a complete predator calling platform that is unique, versatile, all wrapped up in a high-performance package. 
All predator hunting sounds packaged in Convergent Hunting’s Mobile Predator Calling Apps have been recorded in High Definition and are digitally mastered to provide you with sounds that will elicit responses from even the most wary animals.
This app is designed to be easy-to-use and powerful with expansion options so that you can continue to grow your sound library with the latest and greatest sounds as they become available.
Large buttons for sound playback and decoy control make using the apps in the field very easy. 4 programmable preset call buttons allow you to keep your four favorite sounds “front and center” for quick use.
A decoy button lets you easily control the Bullet HP’s decoy motor to further entice game into close range.
Standard volume control and playback interface keep things simple and easy to use. Hunting hi-tech has never been so easy, or powerful!
Visit ConvergentHunting.com for more apps product information.

bluejetty:00038909:ios.description:
대한민국 1위 비대면진료 앱, 닥터나우
* 2026, 2025 한경비즈니스 한국소비자만족지수 비대면진료 앱 2년 연속 1위
* 2024 주간동아 한국고객만족도 비대면진료 앱 1위
■ 병원에서 전화가 온다, 닥터나우
- 감기, 소아과, 여성질환, 여드름, 탈모 등 병원이 필요한 모든 순간에 병원에서 전화가 와요.
- 늦은 밤, 주말, 연휴에도 병원 진료가 가능해요. 365일 24시간 내가 원할 때 언제, 어디서든 편하게 진료를 받아보세요.
- 이제 아플 때 참지 마세요. 이동 없이 진료받고, 내 근처 약국에서 약을 빠르게 받을 수 있어요.
■ 800만의 선택, 닥터나우
- 이미 수많은 사람들이 믿고 쓰고 있어요. 다운로드 수와 리뷰 수가 입증하는 대한민국 1위 서비스를 경험해보세요.
- 90만 개가 넘는 진료 후기와 전문의 여부를 확인해 내가 원하는 의사 선생님에게 진료를 신청할 수 있어요. 소아과부터 산부인과까지 안심하고 진료받아 보세요.
■ 비대면 진료 서비스
- 소아과 비대면 진료, 산부인과 비대면 진료, 비뇨기과 비대면 진료, 이비인후과 비대면 진료, 피부과 비대면 진료, 내과 비대면 진료, 정형외과 비대면 진료, 안과 비대면 진료, 신경과 비대면 진료, 치과 비대면 진료, 가정의학과 비대면 진료, 정신건강의학과 비대면 진료, 통증의학과 비대면 진료
- 소아청소년과약(소아과약) 처방, 산부인과약 처방, 정신과약 처방, 피부과약 처방, 내과약 처방, 이비인후과약 처방, 안과약 처방, 신경과약 처방, 가정의학과약 처방, 통증의학과약 처방, 정신건강의학과약(정신과약) 처방, 정형외과약 처방, 비뇨기과약 처방
■ 비대면 진료 가능한 질환/증상
1. 급여 질환 : 감기약 처방, 독감약 처방, 비염약 처방(항히스타민제, 나잘스프레이 등), 천식약 처방(천식 흡입기 처방), 질염약 처방(항생제, 질정, 질연고 등), 방광염약 처방, 입덧약 처방, 소아과약 처방, 불면증약/우울증약/불안증약/긴장완화약 처방(향정신성의약품 제외), 알러지/알레르기약 처방, 안구건조증 1회용 인공눈물 처방(히알루론산 인공눈물 등), 결막염약 처방(안약, 안연고 등), 다래끼약 처방, 고혈압약 처방, 고지혈증약 처방, 당뇨약 처방, 위장약 처방, 장염약 처방, 위염약 처방, 식도염약 처방, 소화불량약 처방, 변비약 처방, 발톱무좀약 처방, 헤르페스약 처방, 두드러기약 처방, 피부발진/습진약 처방, 아토피약 처방, 근육통약 처방, 통풍약 처방, 두통약 처방, 전립선약 처방, 생리통약 처방
2. 비급여 질환 : 먹는 탈모약 처방(피나스테리드 - 프로페시아, 피나온 등 / 두타스테리드 - 아보다트, 두타온 등), 바르는 탈모약 처방(미녹시딜 - 로게인폼, 미녹시폼, 마이녹실), 먹는 여드름약 처방(이소트레티노인 - 이소티논, 트레인 / 독시사이클린 - 미노씬, 모노신정), 바르는 여드름약 처방(클린다마이신 - 크레오신티, 아다팔렌 - 디페린겔, 트리파로텐 - 아크리프)
 - 365일 24시간 언제 어디서든 전화로 빠르게 닥터나우에서 진료 받을 수 있어요. 25만 개가 넘는 후기를 보고 나만의닥터를 찾아보세요. 좋은 선생님 굿닥부터 모두에게 필요한 모두닥 똑닥 병원에 비대면진료 예약까지 가능해요. 삐약 하며 얻는 정보 닥터나우에서 다 얻을 수 있어요. 내가 있는 곳 어디든 전국에 있는 병원에서 대기 없이 비대면진료 받아 보세요.
■ 진료비 최저가 비교
- 진료받기 전에 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등)의 최저가 진료비 병원을 찾아보세요.
- 모아둔 포인트로 진료비 할인도 받을 수 있으니 병원비를 절약해보세요. (*다이어트는 최저가로 병원 예약 기능도 편하게 이용할 수 있어요.)
■ 최저가 약국 지도
- 전국의 약국 가격과 약국 정보를 지도를 통해 한 눈에 확인할 수 있어요.
- 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 가격을 비교해보고 나에게 딱 맞는 최저가 약국에서 약을 받아보세요.
- 온누리상품권 가맹 약국을 필터로 한 번에 찾고, 추가 할인 받아 약값 부담도 줄여보세요.
■ 다이어트 병원 방문 예약
- 다어어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 진료와 처방이 가능한 병원을 방문하기 전에 미리 예약할 수 있어요.
- 다이어트 진료 최저가 병원과 최저가 약국을 확인하여 편하게 병원 예약해보세요.
■ 실시간 상담
- 감기, 장염, 탈모 초기 증상, 여드름과 같은 피부 고민, 다이어트, 여성 질환, 아이 감기, 수족구 등 건강에 관련된 궁금한 내용을 물어보면 AI가 실시간으로 빠르게 답변해 드려요.
■ 건강 정보 - 건강 매거진, 1분 FAQ, 의약품 사전, 질환백과
- 건강 매거진 : 소아과, 여성질환, 피부, 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트 등 다양한 건강 정보를 전문 에디터가 제공해드려요. 건강검진과 예방접종, 피부 시술까지 다양한 정보를 확인할 수 있어요.
- 1분 FAQ : 다이어트, BMI, 당뇨, 고혈압, 고지혈증, 혈압, 혈당 등 다양한 건강 정보를 빠르게 제공해요. 원하는 내용을 간편하게 확인해 보세요.
- 의약품 사전 : 많이 찾는 일반의약품과 전문의약품의 자세한 정보를 확인할 수 있어요. 처방받은 약의 효능/효과부터 부작용, 주의사항까지 꼼꼼하게 확인해 보세요.
- 질환백과 : 내과, 산부인과, 소아청소년과, 피부과, 비뇨기과, 이비인후과 비대면 진료, 정형외과, 안과, 신경과, 치과, 가정의학과, 정신건강의학과, 통증의학과 등 다양한 질환에 대한 정보를 제공해요. 원인부터 증상, 치료 등 원하는 정보를 빠르게 찾을 수 있어요.
