listings.description:
대한민국 1위 비대면진료 앱, 닥터나우
* 2026, 2025 한경비즈니스 한국소비자만족지수 비대면진료 앱 2년 연속 1위
* 2024 주간동아 한국고객만족도 비대면진료 앱 1위

■ 병원에서 전화가 온다, 닥터나우

- 감기, 소아과, 여성질환, 여드름, 탈모 등 병원이 필요한 모든 순간에 병원에서 전화가 와요.
- 늦은 밤, 주말, 연휴에도 병원 진료가 가능해요. 365일 24시간 내가 원할 때 언제, 어디서든 편하게 진료를 받아보세요.
- 이제 아플 때 참지 마세요. 이동 없이 진료받고, 내 근처 약국에서 약을 빠르게 받을 수 있어요.

■ 800만의 선택, 닥터나우

- 이미 수많은 사람들이 믿고 쓰고 있어요. 다운로드 수와 리뷰 수가 입증하는 대한민국 1위 서비스를 경험해보세요.
- 90만 개가 넘는 진료 후기와 전문의 여부를 확인해 내가 원하는 의사 선생님에게 진료를 신청할 수 있어요. 소아과부터 산부인과까지 안심하고 진료받아 보세요.

■ 비대면 진료 서비스

- 소아과 비대면 진료, 산부인과 비대면 진료, 비뇨기과 비대면 진료, 이비인후과 비대면 진료, 피부과 비대면 진료, 내과 비대면 진료, 정형외과 비대면 진료, 안과 비대면 진료, 신경과 비대면 진료, 치과 비대면 진료, 가정의학과 비대면 진료, 정신건강의학과 비대면 진료, 통증의학과 비대면 진료
- 소아청소년과약(소아과약) 처방, 산부인과약 처방, 정신과약 처방, 피부과약 처방, 내과약 처방, 이비인후과약 처방, 안과약 처방, 신경과약 처방, 가정의학과약 처방, 통증의학과약 처방, 정신건강의학과약(정신과약) 처방, 정형외과약 처방, 비뇨기과약 처방

■ 비대면 진료 가능한 질환/증상

1. 급여 질환 : 감기약 처방, 독감약 처방, 비염약 처방(항히스타민제, 나잘스프레이 등), 천식약 처방(천식 흡입기 처방), 질염약 처방(항생제, 질정, 질연고 등), 방광염약 처방, 입덧약 처방, 소아과약 처방, 불면증약/우울증약/불안증약/긴장완화약 처방(향정신성의약품 제외), 알러지/알레르기약 처방, 안구건조증 1회용 인공눈물 처방(히알루론산 인공눈물 등), 결막염약 처방(안약, 안연고 등), 다래끼약 처방, 고혈압약 처방, 고지혈증약 처방, 당뇨약 처방, 위장약 처방, 장염약 처방, 위염약 처방, 식도염약 처방, 소화불량약 처방, 변비약 처방, 발톱무좀약 처방, 헤르페스약 처방, 두드러기약 처방, 피부발진/습진약 처방, 아토피약 처방, 근육통약 처방, 통풍약 처방, 두통약 처방, 전립선약 처방, 생리통약 처방
2. 비급여 질환 : 먹는 탈모약 처방(피나스테리드 - 프로페시아, 피나온 등 / 두타스테리드 - 아보다트, 두타온 등), 바르는 탈모약 처방(미녹시딜 - 로게인폼, 미녹시폼, 마이녹실), 먹는 여드름약 처방(이소트레티노인 - 이소티논, 트레인 / 독시사이클린 - 미노씬, 모노신정), 바르는 여드름약 처방(클린다마이신 - 크레오신티, 아다팔렌 - 디페린겔, 트리파로텐 - 아크리프)
    
    - 365일 24시간 언제 어디서든 전화로 빠르게 닥터나우에서 진료 받을 수 있어요. 25만 개가 넘는 후기를 보고 나만의닥터를 찾아보세요. 좋은 선생님 굿닥부터 모두에게 필요한 모두닥 똑닥 병원에 비대면진료 예약까지 가능해요. 삐약 하며 얻는 정보 닥터나우에서 다 얻을 수 있어요. 내가 있는 곳 어디든 전국에 있는 병원에서 대기 없이 비대면진료 받아 보세요.
    

■ 진료비 최저가 비교

- 진료받기 전에 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등)의 최저가 진료비 병원을 찾아보세요.
- 모아둔 포인트로 진료비 할인도 받을 수 있으니 병원비를 절약해보세요. (*다이어트는 최저가로 병원 예약 기능도 편하게 이용할 수 있어요.)

■ 최저가 약국 지도

- 전국의 약국 가격과 약국 정보를 지도를 통해 한 눈에 확인할 수 있어요.
- 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 가격을 비교해보고 나에게 딱 맞는 최저가 약국에서 약을 받아보세요.
- 온누리상품권 가맹 약국을 필터로 한 번에 찾고, 추가 할인 받아 약값 부담도 줄여보세요.

■ 다이어트 병원 방문 예약

- 다어어트(위고비, 마운자로 등) 진료와 처방이 가능한 병원을 방문하기 전에 미리 예약할 수 있어요.
- 다이어트 진료 최저가 병원과 최저가 약국을 확인하여 편하게 병원 예약해보세요.

■ 실시간 상담

- 감기, 장염, 탈모 초기 증상, 여드름과 같은 피부 고민, 다이어트, 여성 질환, 아이 감기, 수족구 등 건강에 관련된 궁금한 내용을 물어보면 AI가 실시간으로 빠르게 답변해 드려요.

■ 건강 정보 - 건강 매거진, 1분 FAQ, 의약품 사전, 질환백과

- 건강 매거진 : 소아과, 여성질환, 피부, 탈모, 여드름, 다이어트 등 다양한 건강 정보를 전문 에디터가 제공해드려요. 건강검진과 예방접종, 피부 시술까지 다양한 정보를 확인할 수 있어요.

bluejetty:00017793:ios.description:
Rated 5 stars and loved by thousands of users!
Unlike traditional complicated budgeting apps, Daily Budget Original focuses on being simple, easy and actually fun to use.
-- SAFE & PRIVATE –-
The app does not connect to bank accounts, so there is no need to enter your online banking log in data.
Also, we do not sell user data. The data stays on your device only. If you want to sync your data, you can encrypt it before uploading it to the cloud.
-- KEY FEATURES ARE FREE, FOREVER --
Many users are happy and saving a lot of money with the free version, without any additional paid features. 
Free features: Daily Budget calculation, planning & saving for big spending, basic categories for expenses, backup.
Paid features: More and customizable categories, data encryption, PIN protection, Multi users via Dropbox, Remove ads, CSV file export, analysis graphs.
-- USER REVIEWS –-
Beyond spectacular! - This app is so fantastic- as with many other reviewers, I've tried other budgeting apps like Mint. But this is the only app that actually works. It incentives me to spend less money on some days, have extra to spend on the weekends. Thank you for not adding too many bells and whistles!
Life Changing - I am the WORST with finances and I've tried other apps, including Mint, which I used for a week and quit. But this app?? It's amazing. I can't speak highly enough of how much this app is getting my life together. I'm aggressively saving, paying off all of my bills and I know exactly what I get to spend a day. I will never NOT use this. I hope it's here forever.
Helps you be Accountable - This app turns my financial life into a game that I feel I can win. Daily Budget really works and it's core design sets it apart from other apps.
-- IN MEDIA –-
“Take the blah out of budgeting” – Seventeen Magazine
 “An utterly fantastic approach to saving” – Apppicker
“Super-quick, easy way to show how well we're doing” - Appadvice
-- HOW IT WORKS --
1. Enter your regular income, like salary or monthly allowance.
2. Enter your recurring expenses, like rent or gym.
3. Enter your savings goal, like 10%.
4. Watch your Daily Budget gets calculated and know how much you can spend every day!
*Daily Budget is calculated simply as (Income – Expenses – Saving)/Number of days in a month. 
Watch your budget grow as you stay below your daily budget. Now, saving money is suddenly a fun game!

bluejetty:00023493:ios.description:
Create pixel art, animated sprites and game assets on iPhone and iPad. Draw with layers, animate frame by frame, and export your work as images, GIFs or sprite sheets.
Start with a small character or build a detailed scene. Pixel Studio PRO brings drawing, animation and color tools together, with Apple Pencil support and a customizable workspace. Get PRO features with a one-time purchase, including an ad-free workspace, Google Drive sync and advanced creative tools.
DRAW PIXEL ART
• Work with layers, built-in and custom brushes, shapes and gradients
• Draw symmetrically and add shading with the Dithering Pen
• Use Dot Pen for precise drawing with a cursor
• Customize your grid, background and toolbar
• Resize and rotate your canvas, with pixel art scaling and rotation tools
• Create seamless textures with Tile Mode
ANIMATE YOUR SPRITES
• Create frame-by-frame animations with Onion Skin
• Export animations as GIFs or sprite sheets
• Add music and export videos to MP4 without limits
WORK WITH COLOR
• Create your own palettes with up to 256 colors or use built-in palettes and palettes from Lospec
• Pick colors with RGBA and HSV controls
• Extract palettes from images and apply palettes to your artwork
• Adjust hue, saturation and lightness without limits
SAVE AND SHARE
• Use autosave and backups to help protect your projects
• Sync your work between supported devices and platforms with Google Drive
• Work with PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TGA and Pixel Studio Project files
• Import Aseprite files
• Share your artwork with the Pixel Network community
PRO FEATURES INCLUDED
• No ads
• Google Drive sync across supported platforms
• Dark theme
• 256-color palettes
• Tile Mode for seamless textures
• Extended maximum project size
• Unlimited color adjustments and MP4 exports
• Additional format support
• Extended Pixel Network storage
Sample images by lorddkno, Redshrike, Calciumtrice, Buch and Tomoe Mami are used under CC BY 3.0.
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/hippogamesunity/PixelStudioHub/wiki/Privacy-Policy
Terms of Use: https://github.com/hippogamesunity/PixelStudioHub/wiki/EULA

bluejetty:00033717:ios.description:
Introducing Match Score, the essential app for every football enthusiast. With Match Score, you can stay effortlessly connected to the world of football, accessing a wealth of information right at your fingertips. From match schedules to results, Match Score ensures you're always in the loop.
Key Features:
Upcoming Matches & Results:
Never miss a game again! Match Score provides a comprehensive schedule of all upcoming matches, allowing you to plan your viewing in advance. Additionally, you can easily check the results of past matches, keeping you up to date with the latest developments in the football world.
Favorites:
Track your favorite teams and matches with ease. Match Score's Favorites feature lets you select the teams and matches that matter most to you. Receive real-time notifications when these matches are about to start, ensuring you never miss a moment of the action.
Predictions:
Enhance your game-day experience with expert insights and predictions. Match Score offers detailed analysis and predictions for today's matches, helping you stay informed and engaged. Whether you're a casual fan or a seasoned follower, these predictions add an extra layer of excitement to your football experience.
Stay effortlessly connected to the football world with Match Score. Download the app today and make it your go-to source for all football updates and information.

bluejetty:00025734:android.description:
Looking for a game that's both challenging and relaxing? Look no further than "Clothes Sort Puzzle" - the ultimate brain-teasing challenge that doubles as a stress-relieving escape.
In this game, your objective is to sort clothes by color. It's a simple gameplay mechanic, but as you progress through the levels, the difficulty ramps up, and you'll need to rely on your brainly abilities to remember which colors belong together.
With beautiful graphics, soothing sound effects, and ASMR elements, "Clothes Sort Puzzle" is a game that will keep you engaged and relaxed for hours on end. And if you're looking for a way to unwind after a stressful day, this game is the perfect way to do it.
Research shows that puzzle games like "Clothes Sort Puzzle" can help reduce stress and improve your overall mood, making it an ideal addition to your daily routine. So why not take a break from the daily grind and give this game a try?
Whether you're a fan of other sorting games like Puzzledom and Filler, or simply looking for a fun way to unwind, "Clothes Sort Puzzle" is the game for you. Download it today and see how far you can go. And don't forget to stay hydrated with plenty of water - your brain and body will thank you!

bluejetty:00024698:ios.name: LA Wallet
bluejetty:00024698:ios.summary: LA Wallet will allow you to keep a digital representation of your current Louisiana-issued state ID or driver's license. The app will generate a unique image that is 100% Legal for driving purposes per Louisiana law of Act 625 of the 2016 s
bluejetty:00024698:ios.description: LA Wallet will allow you to keep a digital representation of your current Louisiana-issued state ID or driver's license. The app will generate a unique image that is 100% Legal for driving purposes per Louisiana law of Act 625 of the 2016 session and approved by the Louisiana ATC for age-restricted purchases at various local restaurants, bars, and retail outlets. Once a user activates their current, valid license in LA Wallet, the digital driver’s license is valid for the life of the user’s current identity credential issuance. When the user’s physical license expires, they must renew their license with the OMV or through the LA Wallet app, if eligible. Additionally, LA Wallet offers the paid service VerifyYou™ Pro, an age-verification tool that helps keep businesses ATC compliant when offering home delivery of age-restricted goods.

bluejetty:00014572:ios.description:
Photo Retouch is a photo and video editing tool for removing visual distractions, refining portraits, and creating polished edits.
Key features:
• Object Removal: Brush over distracting objects or background passersby and apply the edit.
• Photo and Video Retouching: Make local corrections, blur selected areas, and track moving subjects in videos.
• Portrait Tools: Adjust facial proportions, eyes, nose, mouth, skin tone, texture, and the appearance of fine lines.
• Makeup, Hairstyle, Hair Color and Virtual Try-On: Preview different makeup styles, hairstyles, hair colors, nail designs, and predefined virtual try-on options.
• Background Editing: Automatically separate subjects and replace or blur backgrounds.
• Photo Editing Tools: Crop, blur, adjust light and color, apply filters and effects, add text, create collages, and use other creative editing tools.
• AI-Assisted Tools: Expand images, restore older photos, add color, preview hairstyles.
• AI Photo Enhancement: Improve photo clarity, details, lighting, and overall quality.
• Future Baby: Create simulated baby appearances from selected photos using AI-assisted generation for entertainment and creative purposes.
• Photo Repair: Improve the perceived clarity and color of older or blurry photos.
• Live Photo & Beauty Camera: Apply supported edits to Live Photos and use built-in beauty camera features.
• Video Retouching: Apply supported retouching, blur, tracking, and editing tools to videos.
• Cloud Backup: Save edited results through the app’s cloud storage feature.
Portrait adjustments are creative visual effects and are not medical treatments. Results may vary depending on the source image.
Premium Package Subscription
- You can subscribe for large cloud storage space & premium features
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to use large cloud storage space & premium features for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one week"/"one month"/"one year" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package (weekly, monthly or yearly package)
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

bluejetty:00036520:ios.description:
The enjoyable hidden object games that have become a favorite among many is now available online! Dive into Magic Find: Hidden Object Game and embark on an exciting adventure where every level is a new challenge. Whether you love hidden object games, puzzle games, or brain games, this game offers a perfect blend of fun, challenge, and relaxation.
In this thrilling hide and seek experience, your mission is simple: find all the hidden objects scattered across beautifully crafted scenes. But don’t be fooled by the simplicity—each level gets progressively more challenging, making it a true test of your observational skills. Are you ready to prove your hunting prowess?
Key Features
• Free to Play: Enjoy one of the most relaxing hidden object games for free, with no hidden costs.
• Engaging Hidden Object Gameplay: If you love hidden object games, you’ll be captivated by the beautifully designed scenes filled with cleverly concealed items. Whether you’re into hide and seek or enjoy the thrill of hunting for hidden treasures, this puzzle game has it all.
• Challenging Puzzles: Each level presents a new challenge, making it one of the best puzzle games and mind games available. Your observational skills and mental sharpness will be put to the test as you search for hidden objects in increasingly complex scenarios.
• Relaxing Experience: Unwind with one of the most soothing relaxing games on the market. The calming visuals and serene gameplay make it easy to lose yourself in the hunt, providing a perfect balance between challenge and relaxation.
• Diverse Environments: Explore a variety of settings, from enchanted forests to mysterious castles. Each location is packed with secrets waiting to be uncovered, offering endless exploration for fans of hidden object games and puzzle games.
• Endless Levels: With hundreds of levels and regular updates, there’s always something new to discover. Whether you’re a seasoned player of hidden object games or a newcomer to brain games, you’ll find endless hide and seek entertainment in Magic Find.
• Zoom Feature: Zoom in and out to spot even the most well-hidden items.
How to Play
Observe: Carefully examine each scene to spot the hidden objects listed.
Seek: Use hints to help find elusive items when you get stuck.
Zoom: Zoom in to discover hidden details that you might have missed.
Complete: Find all hidden objects to progress to the next level.
Search, seek, and find out in magic graphics, collecting hundreds of hidden objects for endless scavenger hunt fun. If you're a fan of find out hidden objects games, spot it games, and other brain games, this free brain teaser is the perfect fit for you!
Magic Find: Hidden Object Game isn’t just another game—it’s a journey filled with discovery, excitement, and relaxation. Whether you're hunting for hidden objects or solving intricate puzzles, the scavenger hunt games will keep your mind engaged and your spirit relaxed.
Download now and start your adventure today! The world of hidden object games, puzzle games, and mind games awaits you. Embark on a journey that will sharpen your mind while providing hours of relaxing fun!

bluejetty:00023619:ios.description:
One-week free trial.
TslaMirror is an app designed to mirror your iPhone/iPad apps to your Tesla’s built-in browser.
- Supported apps include Waze, Google Maps, Apple Maps, YouTube, TikTok, Plex, and more.
- DRM-protected apps, including but not limited to Netflix, Apple TV, YouTube TV, Amazon Prime Video, and Hulu, are not supported. Some DRM-protected apps may block video mirroring, resulting in a black screen in the Tesla browser.
Instructions for the Tesla built-in browser:
1. If possible, update your Tesla’s infotainment system to the most recent version.
2. Make sure the vehicle is PARKED (0 mph / 0 km/h).
3. Connect your Tesla to your iPhone Personal Hotspot (cellular data required). MCU2 or MCU3 hardware is required: available on Model 3 and Model Y, Cybertruck, Model S built after March 2018, Model X built after March 2018, or vehicles upgraded from MCU1 to MCU2/3.
4. Ensure the iPhone is not in Low Power Mode. Launch the TslaMirror app and toggle on “Proxy.”
5. Tap “Start,” then select “Start Broadcast” to begin screen broadcast.
6. In your Tesla’s built-in browser, go to https://TslaMirror.com
7. Lossless audio playback is supported in the browser.
8. Keep your iPhone unlocked; due to Screen Broadcast API limitations, locking the screen stops casting and requires restarting the broadcast.
Key Features
1. No additional internet traffic is used for mirroring; traffic stays on the iPhone’s Personal Hotspot. However, while the Tesla is connected to the hotspot, the vehicle may use your cellular data for its own internet access.
2. Private: the screencast is only available to devices connected to the iPhone Personal Hotspot Wi-Fi network.
3. A 5 GHz Personal Hotspot (supported from the iPhone 12 series) is highly recommended. Do not enable “Maximize Compatibility” on iPhone 12 models; enabling it forces a 2.4 GHz hotspot.
4. H.264/H.265 mirroring recommendations:
 - MCU3 (AMD Ryzen): H.265 mode with 720p@60 fps recommended, as 1080p requires higher bandwidth. MCU3 supports up to 1080p@60fps (H.264 and H.265).
 - For Tesla in-car system software version 2025.38.11 and later, H.265 mirroring is now recommended for both MCU2 and MCU3.
 - MCU2 (Intel Atom): H.264 mode with 540p@30fps recommended only for very old Tesla in-car system.
FAQ
1. This is not CarPlay.
2. iOS apps that use the AVPlayer framework (e.g., Apple Music, Netflix) are not supported.
3. Netflix is not supported.
Privacy/Security Notice: This app does not collect usage statistics, personal information, or analytics. On iOS 13 and later, it uses Location Services only to read the Wi-Fi network name (SSID). Location data is never stored or collected. No information is stored by us.
Disclaimer: This software and documentation are not affiliated with or endorsed by Tesla, Inc. Use at your own risk. We do not guarantee proper functioning. Some features require specific vehicle options (e.g., MCU2 or newer). The app uses interfaces similar to those used by official Tesla apps, but you are responsible for any changes to your car resulting from use. Use requires the vehicle’s built-in browser. We are not liable for any damages to you, your car, or any other property in conjunction with the use of this app.
Warning and Legal Disclaimer: Use only while PARKED (0 mph / 0 km/h). Local laws may restrict the use of a built-in web browser in a vehicle.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://teslamirror.com/terms 
Privacy Policy: https://teslamirror.com/privacy

bluejetty:00034798:ios.description:
NumberBox is a simple and secure tool that allows users to voluntarily report unwanted or spam phone numbers to help keep the community safe.
Users can manually add tags to phone numbers — for example, “Scammer,” “Telemarketing,” or “Spam.”
All tags are submitted voluntarily by users to help others recognize potentially unwanted calls.
Privacy & Data Policy
NumberBox does not collect, store, or share any personal data.
The app does not access contacts, call history, messages, or any other private information.
All user-submitted tags are stored anonymously and are not linked to personal identities.
Contact & Support
If you have any questions, or wish to modify or remove user-submitted data, please contact us through the in-app support section or via our official support email.

bluejetty:00026987:ios.summary:
Get dressed for the weather, not just told about it.
Weather Fit turns the forecast into something you can see. A character that looks like you puts on clothes that match the conditions outside, so before you even read the temperature, you
bluejetty:00026987:ios.description:
Get dressed for the weather, not just told about it.
Weather Fit turns the forecast into something you can see. A character that looks like you puts on clothes that match the conditions outside, so before you even read the temperature, you already know if it's a sweater day, a raincoat day, or a sunglasses day.
Hourly, daily, and minute by minute forecasts powered by Apple Weather. Made for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
A character that dresses for the day. Morning, afternoon, evening, and night, your character changes clothes as the weather changes. It's the fastest way to know what to wear before you walk out the door.
Dressed like you. Pick a character, choose a hairstyle, skin tone, and hair color, then pick their clothes: jackets, sweaters, shirts, dresses, shoes, and accessories. Only what you'd actually wear.
Outfits tuned to you. A comfort slider tells the app whether you run hot or cold, and the suggestions adjust. No more being told to wear a coat when you're already sweating.
Forecasts that cover everything. Next hour precipitation, weather alerts, and a stats grid for UV, wind, air quality, humidity, pressure, visibility, sunrise and sunset, and moon phase.
Beautiful to look at. Animated landscapes, dynamic skies, and weather effects that shift with the time of day. Pick from City, Mountains, Beach, or Village.
NOTIFICATIONS
Wake up knowing what to wear. Your character gets dressed for the day and arrives in a morning notification, with an evening one to plan tomorrow. And when rain or strong sun is coming, a reminder tells you to grab an umbrella or sunscreen.
WIDGETS
Home Screen widgets in every size, with or without your character on them. Lock Screen widgets too, inline above the clock and circular or rectangular below it, so the forecast and your outfit are one glance away.
APPLE WATCH
A full Weather Fit app on the wrist, plus complications for your favorite watch face. Your character, the temperature, and what's coming next, right where you'll see it.
WEATHER MAPS
Animated precipitation radar from Rainbow.ai. Watch rain and snow move across the map for the next hour, frame by frame.
ICLOUD SYNC
Your character, wardrobe, saved locations, and settings stay in sync across all your devices and back up to iCloud automatically. Switch phones without losing a thing.
WEATHER FIT PREMIUM
A subscription unlocks the full experience:
- Unlimited wardrobe items and outfit combinations
- All four landscapes (City, Mountains, Beach, Village)
- Weather report and reminder notifications
- Every Home Screen and Lock Screen widget
- The Apple Watch app and complications
- Weather Maps with precipitation radar
Choose monthly, yearly, or a one time lifetime purchase. Free trial available for new subscribers.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel anytime from your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://weatherfit.com/terms-and-conditions.html
Privacy Policy: https://weatherfit.com/privacy-policy.html
---

bluejetty:00032885:ios.name: Palo Alto Link
bluejetty:00032885:ios.summary: Palo Alto Link is the city’s easy, affordable, and eco-friendly service. We are a rideshare service that comes when you want, where you want — give us your pickup and dropoff addresses, and we’ll provide a few ride options. Choose the ride
bluejetty:00032885:ios.description:
Palo Alto Link is the city’s easy, affordable, and eco-friendly service. We are a rideshare service that comes when you want, where you want — give us your pickup and dropoff addresses, and we’ll provide a few ride options. Choose the ride option that works best for you and get directions to a nearby intersection where a driver will pick you up.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices and lowers CO2 emissions. Enough said.

apple-macos:972696951.name: Origami Art Studio
apple-macos:972696951.description:
Origami Art Studio is a calm, beautifully simple companion for learning the ancient craft of paper folding. Browse a growing catalog of 30+ models — from a classic paper crane, heart, and boat to more ambitious stars, dragons, and dragonflies — and follow a clear, photographed guide through every single fold. There is no clutter, no timer, and no pressure: just you, a square of paper, and one gentle step at a time.
Every model opens into a fullscreen step viewer. Each step is shown as a real photo, so you can see exactly where the paper bends, which corner meets which edge, and how the shape slowly comes to life in your hands. A progress bar and a clear "Step X of Y" label always tell you how far along you are, so it is easy to pause, set the device down to make a fold, and pick up right where you left off.
Moving through a guide feels natural. Swipe left or right to go forward and back, tap the on-screen arrows, or use the keyboard arrow keys on iPad and Mac. When you reach the final step a friendly "Done" button brings you home to choose your next project. The home screen is a tidy, paginated catalog with thumbnail previews and a step count on every card, so you always know how involved a model will be before you begin.
Origami Art Studio is built to feel good on any device. The washi-paper interface — soft cream tones, warm ink lettering, and a single terracotta accent — was designed to be quiet and relaxing rather than loud and gamified. The responsive layout automatically shows one, two, three, or four columns depending on your screen, filling iPhone and iPad edge to edge without awkward borders. Gentle tap sounds give the pages a paper-like feel, and a single tap on the sound icon mutes them whenever you want silence.
The whole app speaks your language. A built-in language menu offers eight fully translated interfaces — English, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, Hindi, and French — so menus, buttons, and labels always feel like home. Switching is instant and remembered for next time.
Whether you are folding with a child on a rainy afternoon, calming your mind after a long day, or picking up a mindful new hobby, Origami Art Studio keeps everything you need in one uncluttered place. Start with a simple crane today, then work your way up to a many-step dragon when you are ready. Grab a square of paper and begin folding.
Origami Art Studio never asks you to rush. There are no lives to lose, no daily streaks to maintain, and no ad ever interrupts a delicate fold mid-crease — an occasional short ad appears only when you open a new guide. Sit with one photograph as long as you need, then glide to the next when your hands are ready. The catalog grows with classic and creative shapes, so there is always a new project waiting — whether you have five minutes for a heart or a quiet evening for a many-step dragon.
Highlights you will notice right away:
• 30+ origami models with a clear photo for every fold
• Fullscreen step viewer with progress and Step X of Y
• Swipe, tap, or keyboard navigation on every device
• Paginated catalog with thumbnails and step counts
• Calm washi-paper design that fills the screen
• Eight fully translated languages
• Optional tap sounds with a one-tap mute
Fold slowly. Fold carefully. Fold for the joy of watching flat paper become something alive.
